name: Select
summary: A styled native select: one value picked from a platform-drawn list, wearing Input's appearances and sizes. Choose it when the options are plain strings and the platform's own popup is acceptable; choose Combobox or Dropdown for custom option content, multiselect or typing.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: Colour and border treatment, as Input's.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Height (24, 32, 40), text style, padding and icon size together; matches Input.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: The native options: a value and a text each, optionally disabled or grouped.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: The end icon, a down chevron by default, drawn over the select and not clickable.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Native disabled: disabled colours and no popup.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: aria-invalid: the border reads colorPaletteRedBorder2 while focus is not within.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Runs with the new value when the user picks an option.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: A flex row wrapping the select and the icon, position relative so the icon and focus line can be placed over it; it receives className and style.

anatomy.name: Select
anatomy.description: The native select element with its own appearance removed: the field's fill, border, radius, padding and text style; it grows to fill the root.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: The chevron, absolutely placed at the end inside the select's padding, colorNeutralStrokeAccessible, 16, 20 or 24px, taking no pointer events.

anatomy.name: Focus line
anatomy.description: The root's ::after: a bottom strip as tall as borderRadiusMedium whose lower half is colorCompoundBrandStroke, scaled from zero width while focus is within.

variants.description: Background 1 fill and a 1px Stroke 1 border whose bottom edge is StrokeAccessible; hover and press step the side borders only.
Transparent background, no radius, only a 1px StrokeAccessible bottom border; native options paint Background 1 so they read in dark themes.
Background 3 fill behind the base 1px transparent border.
Background 1 fill behind the base 1px transparent border.
24px tall, caption1 text, 16px icon, spacingHorizontalSNudge outer padding.
32px tall, body1 text, 20px icon, spacingHorizontalMNudge outer padding.
40px tall, body2 text, 24px icon, spacingHorizontalM outer padding.

layout.text: The select is exactly 24, 32 or 40px tall by size with no vertical padding, a 1px border on every side (transparent where the appearance shows none) and borderRadiusMedium.

Since the native element cannot hold children, its padding folds the outer inset and the inner content padding together: start padding is spacingHorizontalSNudge plus spacingHorizontalXXS at small, MNudge plus XXS at medium, M plus SNudge at large; end padding is the outer inset plus the icon size plus twice the gap (XXS at small and medium, SNudge at large).
The icon is a 16, 20 or 24px square placed at the end inset by spacingHorizontalSNudge, MNudge or M, vertically centred by the root's flex alignment.

The focus line spans the root's bottom edge, as tall as borderRadiusMedium with that radius on its bottom corners, painted by a gradient that fills its lower half with colorCompoundBrandStroke; unlike Input it sits inside the box, not 1px outside.

states.text: Rest: the appearance's fill and border, colorNeutralForeground1 text, colorNeutralStrokeAccessible icon, a pointer cursor and the focus line scaled to zero.
Outline only: the border turns colorNeutralStroke1Hover while the bottom edge stays colorNeutralStrokeAccessible.
Outline only: while pressed the border turns colorNeutralStroke1Pressed, the bottom edge unchanged.

While focus is within, the focus line scales to full width over durationNormal on curveDecelerateMid and back over durationUltraFast on curveAccelerateMid; the select itself declares a 2px transparent outline so no browser ring shows.
aria-invalid on an enabled select: while focus is not within, the border (the bottom border for underline) reads colorPaletteRedBorder2.

A transparent background, colorNeutralStrokeDisabled border (underline: transparent sides with a colorNeutralStrokeDisabled bottom), colorNeutralForegroundDisabled text and icon, and a not-allowed pointer; invalid is not shown while disabled.

behaviour.text: Opening, keyboard navigation and option rendering are the platform's: the component styles only the closed field and overlays its own chevron; the popup list is not themed beyond the underline's option background.
Picking an option fires onChange with the option's value, or its text when it has no value.

keyboard: Space, Enter or Alt+ArrowDown opens the native list
ArrowUp and ArrowDown change the value or move in the list
typing jumps to a matching option
semantics: the native select carries the platform's combobox semantics and its options
disabled and aria-invalid are native attributes on the select
the icon is decorative and takes no pointer events

notes.text: Heights (24, 32, 40px), icon sizes (16, 20, 24px) and the 1px border are constants in the styles file, with a TODO asking whether field heights should be tokens.

Unlike Input, Combobox and SpinButton, the hover and press border keeps its rest StrokeAccessible bottom edge (no Hover or Pressed step) and the focus line is a half-height gradient inside the box rather than a clipped 2px border 1px outside it.

The filled appearances add only a fill; the 1px transparent border comes from the base class, so hover and focus do not draw a TransparentStrokeInteractive border here as Input's filled appearances do.
Under forced colours a disabled select's border and icon read the system GrayText.
